qa_pair.question: Use the Apple MCP tools to find the calendar named "MCP-Eval". How many events are stored in it? Answer with a single integer.
In the calendar "MCP-Eval", what is the location field of the event whose summary is "Project kickoff"? Answer with the literal location string.
Across all calendars, list events whose summary contains the substring "Retro" using apple_search_events. What is the location of the matching event? Answer with the literal location string.
Use apple_list_reminder_lists then apple_list_reminders to count how many *incomplete* reminders live in the list named "MCP-Eval". Answer with a single integer.
In the reminders list "MCP-Eval", which reminder has its `flagged` property set to true? Answer with the exact reminder name.
In the reminders list "MCP-Eval", which reminder has priority equal to 1 (i.e. high priority)? Answer with the exact reminder name.
Use apple_search_contacts to find people whose organization or name matches "Apple MCP Eval Co". How many distinct contacts share this organization? Answer with a single integer.
Find the contact named "MCP Eval Tester" and return the value of their work email address. Answer with just the email address.
Use apple_search_messages to find messages in the Inbox whose subject contains "[MCP-EVAL]". How many such messages are there? Answer with a single integer.
Among the messages whose subject contains "[MCP-EVAL]" in the Inbox, how many are currently unread (readStatus = false)? Answer with a single integer.
